name: Horizon Food Company
summary: Horizon Food Company Limited engages in the cutting, processing, packaging, and wrapping of meat and poultry in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers chilled and frozen poultry, rabbits, birds, and meat, as well as sausages and hamburgers. It also provides meat shawarma, chicken shawarma, and doner kabab under the Iskender brand name. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Dammam, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
